import types

import pytest

import typesystem


def test_init_kwargs_valid_with_defaults_applied():
    class KwSchema(typesystem.Schema):
        name = typesystem.String(max_length=50)
        age = typesystem.Integer(default=0)

    instance = KwSchema(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert instance.name == "Alice"
    assert instance.age == 30
    assert instance["name"] == "Alice"
    assert instance["age"] == 30


def test_init_kwargs_uses_field_default():
    class KwSchema(typesystem.Schema):
        name = typesystem.String(max_length=50)
        age = typesystem.Integer(default=7)

    instance = KwSchema(name="Bob")
    assert instance.name == "Bob"
    assert instance.age == 7
    assert instance.__dict__["age"] == 7


def test_init_kwargs_missing_required_without_default():
    class KwSchema(typesystem.Schema):
        name = typesystem.String(max_length=50)
        age = typesystem.Integer(default=7)

    assert instance.age == 5
    assert "name" not in instance.__dict__
    assert not hasattr(instance, "name")

        name = typesystem.String(max_length=3)
        age = typesystem.Integer(default=0)

        KwSchema(name="toolongvalue", age=1)

    assert "KwSchema" in message
    assert "Invalid argument" in message

        age = typesystem.Integer(default=0)

from typesystem.schemas import Reference, Schema

        name = String()

    assert ref.to is Person
    # line 230 false-branch (already has _target)
    assert ref.target is Person
    # lines 224-226 (lazy _target_string from _target)

    assert ref._target_string == "Person"
    # cached second access still works
    assert ref.target_string == "Person"


def test_reference_string_target_resolves_via_definitions():
    definitions = {"Greeting": String()}
    ref = Reference(to="Greeting", definitions=definitions)

    assert ref._target_string == "Greeting"
    assert ref.target_string == "Greeting"
    # lines 230-235 (lazy _target from definitions)
    assert not hasattr(ref, "_target")
    assert ref.target is definitions["Greeting"]
